info.title: Finance Calendar API
info.summary: Economic releases, central bank decisions and exchange holidays as JSON, CSV and ICS.
info.description: Economic releases, decisions and exchange holidays with per-event publisher provenance and verification status. Coverage, consensus and results vary by source and series; inspect status, last_verified_at and data_stale before use. Cancelled releases remain in calendar/history responses but are excluded from next, upcoming and last pointers. Free for any use, commercial included, with attribution: a visible link to https://www.financecalendar.com wherever the data appears. An API key is required. Create and verify an account, then create a key in the account workspace. Earnings dates are not included. Source-backed crypto events include network schedules, vesting installments, issuer supply projections and governance voting deadlines. Crypto rows use category=crypto, canonical assets, nullable country and impact, and confirmed or estimated timing. Calendar date ranges include overlapping estimated windows; history only includes a date window after its upper bound. Supply projections are not confirmed unlocks or observed circulation; voting deadlines are not proposal outcomes. Retain each record source_license requirements where present and source_rights attribution, evidence and notice for independently normalised facts. Rights metadata does not assert a publisher copyright licence. Aggregator discovery links are separate from independent primary verification; internal provider API evaluation data is not distributed. Quota policy v1: API keys are required for all programmatic data and metadata requests. During the new-account signup offer from 2026-11-04T14:26:23+00:00 to 2026-11-18T14:26:23+00:00, new accounts require confirmed payment for Starter, Pro or Business. Starter is US$9.99/year, billed upfront and renewing yearly until cancelled, with applicable tax included. Starter allows 250 requests/account/day and 5,000 requests/account/calendar month. Registration and email confirmation do not activate paid access. Existing Free accounts retain their applicable allowances; older grandfathered allowances are preserved. Check x-rate-limits.new_signup for the current offer state.

get.description: Retained changes in stable snapshot order, newest first. Follow next_cursor until has_more is false; a single publication can exceed 500 changes with the same timestamp. Pass the cursor alone, or repeat the same since, series, change and limit. Cursors bind to snapshot_generated_at. On 409 restart with the original since and filters and deduplicate repeated changes; only advance the checkpoint after all pages complete. Since accepts YYYY-MM-DD or an ISO datetime with seconds and an explicit timezone; relative dates and timezone-less datetimes are rejected. Since is inclusive and normalized to whole UTC seconds. Beyond 30 days, resync from the full snapshot. Responses are not cached.

get.description: Current-vintage evidence endorsed by the engine field contract, including stale retained values and engine-observed revision_history. Empty output may mean unsupported or missing evidence; inspect reported and /quality. No historical first-print or as_of reconstruction. Entries are per event and role; observation_id can repeat where the same metric/period appears in several occurrences. Stable order is event ID, role, reference period and metric. Follow next_offset with identical filters and snapshot_generated_at; on 409 restart at zero. Uses standard API auth and quotas; JSON only.

Event.description: One scheduled release, decision or market holiday.

country.description: ISO country code, or null for global crypto events. Global is not a country code.

date.description: Publisher calendar date, or the inclusive lower-bound index of date_window_start/end for an estimated month, quarter or year. A lower-bound index is not a confirmed occurrence date.

release_at_utc.description: Exact configured or published instant when available, retaining source seconds. Null for date-only, unknown-time, timed-range and approximate date-window schedules. This is schedule evidence, not proof an activation was observed.

time_local.description: HH:MM in the requested tz (only when ?tz= is given).

period.description: What the data covers, when known.

consensus.description: Market consensus is not currently collected and this field is null. Do not infer a forecast from prior or actual values.

prior.description: The validated prior reference-period observation at its recorded source vintage; null when unsupported. A previous article value, a different metric, and an original first print are not interchangeable.

actual.description: A result backed by the implemented validated official observation contract, or the exact structured Treasury auction summary; null otherwise. Article metadata is not a numerical fallback. Zero is a value, and elapsed time does not establish that a result was collected.

url.description: Preview and results page on financecalendar.com, when one exists.

starts_on.description: First day of a multi-day meeting (only when it differs from date).

note.description: Source note, e.g. a date the official calendar moved.

source_id.description: Publisher connector identifier; null when provenance is unavailable.

native_id.description: Publisher release identifier, when supplied. Stable across date changes.

release_stage.description: Publisher-labelled release stage, e.g. advance, second, third or annual-update. Null when unspecified.

time_precision.description: second/minute for configured or published exact timing; date for a day without confirmed time; range for a timed window; month/quarter/year for an estimated date window; unknown or null when unspecified. A schedule is not proof of observed activation.

last_verified_at.description: Last successful source verification. For verification_method=github-json this is the configuration fetch; for manual records it is the fixed human review time, also recorded in manually_reviewed_at. Snapshot generation is not source verification.

data_stale.description: True when last-good source data is retained through a collection failure, or a manual source review is overdue. False does not establish observed activation or comprehensive live coverage.

time_window_start.description: Start of the publisher-announced release window, with timezone offset. This bound is not an exact publication instant.

time_window_end.description: End of the publisher-announced release window, with timezone offset.

time_role.description: Meaning of the scheduled time or window, e.g. publication or auction-close. An auction close is not the publication time of auction results.

auction.description: Treasury auction security and result fields when available. Numerical values remain publisher decimal strings without unit conversion. Auction closing time is not result publication time.

reference_period.description: Explicit month YYYY-MM, or a weekly ending date YYYY-MM-DD. Inspect frequency and reference_period_kind; never infer this period from the announcement date.

source_value.description: Exact decimal in the publisher measurement scale before canonical conversion. Payroll changes are published in thousands of jobs.

conversion_factor.description: Exact decimal multiplier from source_value to value; 1000 converts payroll thousands into canonical jobs. Never apply this factor a second time.

source_documents.description: Exact publisher documents checked for the current numerical edition. The canonical manifest has edition_fingerprint_sha256.

occurrence_source_documents.description: Original document manifest that verified this occurrence and its reference period. This binding remains separate from later numerical editions.

publisher_reported_revisions.description: Revisions explicitly reported in the publisher edition. Values retain the stated source unit; these are separate from engine-observed revision_history and do not establish original first prints.

historical_first_print.description: False for current-vintage backfills; these are not the values originally known at historical releases.

source_document_sha256.description: Original evidence-document fingerprint when supplied by a document-based numerical source.

revision_history.description: Earlier engine-observed values; no retrospective first-print claim.

source_rights.description: Publisher attribution and public-domain policy evidence for results without an asserted upstream licence.

observations.description: Explicitly mapped official numerical observations. Values are source decimal strings, including zero. known_at/first_seen_at record engine observation, not the original publisher release. Prior is the previous reference period at the current observed vintage; consensus is never inferred.

observation_status.description: Numerical source status, independent of calendar timing verification.

observation_fields.description: Flat actual/prior fields populated by an exact official metric and reference-period match. Matching official values take precedence over article-derived values; the linked article text is not rewritten and consensus is never inferred.

source_reference_period.description: Publisher reference period or explicit publication-bundle description, separate from announcement date. Null when the source does not identify the measured period. A fiscal publication-month slot is an identity aid and must not be substituted for the measured month.

kind.description: Source-specific period kind, e.g. month, quarter, quarter-and-year, half-year, year, week-ending, month-range, fiscal-year or publication-bundle.

reference_month.description: Explicit measured month as YYYY-MM; never inferred from a publication month.

fiscal_year.description: Explicit publisher fiscal-year label, e.g. 2024-25; distinct from a calendar year.

components.description: Explicit source components for a combined reference period or publication bundle. A publication-bundle component may retain the original combined description; it is not a single headline metric.

source_clock.description: Raw publisher clock evidence, distinct from a verified release instant. If timezone is null, release_at_utc and time_local remain null; release_tz only identifies the calendar jurisdiction. Date precision does not imply an all-day event.

clock.description: Publisher clock exactly normalised to HH:MM, where supplied.

timezone.description: Explicitly verified clock timezone, otherwise null.

role.description: Meaning of the source clock, e.g. media-publication or date-only. ECOS availability is a separate clock.

verification.description: Evidence limitation, e.g. timezone-unverified or no-clock-published.

source_license.description: Upstream attribution and licence requirements travel with each adapted record. Retain the original credit, attribution link, source link, licence URL, full notice and adaptation notice when redistributing.

attribution_url.description: Required upstream attribution link where supplied, e.g. https://pattern.plus.

notice.description: Full upstream licence notice where required, e.g. the MIT copyright and permission notice.

source_rights.description: Provenance and access basis for independently normalised factual records. This is not a publisher copyright licence or permission claim; source_license remains null unless an actual upstream licence applies. Retain the attribution, evidence links and notice.

basis.description: Documented factual normalisation or independently verified public-facts basis.

access_basis.description: How primary evidence was accessed, e.g. manual review or an issuer-documented public API.

source_url.description: Primary-source or access documentation supporting this rights basis.

assets.description: Affected assets; empty for economic and exchange holiday rows.

environment.description: Network environment, e.g. mainnet, hoodi or sepolia. Testnet events are not mainnet activation dates.

activation_status.description: Configured activation schedule or roadmap target, not proof the network activation was observed.

token_amount.description: Scheduled quantity when supported by the primary source. Publisher decimal strings are retained; consult token_amount_basis for estimates or upper bounds. This is not proof of transfer or sale.

token_amount_basis.description: Evidence or qualification for token_amount, including issuer upper bounds where applicable.

unlock_status.description: Vesting schedule status; scheduled does not establish an observed token release.

schedule_id.description: Stable identifier of the independently normalised vesting schedule.

installment.description: Schedule installment index as emitted by the collector; no convention is implied across publishers.

beneficiaries.description: Primary-source allocation group or groups; not individual token holders.

date_basis.description: Basis of the indexed date or estimated window, e.g. issuer-monthly-schedule or issuer-monthly-projection.

projection_status.description: Supply projection status, e.g. issuer-estimate. A projection is not a confirmed token unlock or observed circulating supply.

projected_circulating_supply.description: Issuer projected circulating supply. Decimal strings are preserved without rounding.

projected_monthly_supply_change.description: Change between issuer monthly projections; not an observed release or confirmed discrete unlock. Decimal strings are preserved.

proposal_title.description: Short factual proposal label when available; null when omitted. Full proposal bodies are not distributed.

voting_end.description: Scheduled voting deadline. It does not establish proposal approval, rejection or execution.

voting_state.description: Voting window state, not a vote result.

voting_type.description: Upstream voting method, e.g. basic, copeland, ranked-choice, single-choice or weighted; additional methods may appear.

choice_count.description: Number of available voting choices. Choice labels, votes and scores are not distributed.

provider.description: Upstream licensed schedule provider, when applicable. Provider evidence is not a claim of independent Finance Calendar verification.

provider_token.description: Token identifier within the provider dataset.

provider_basis.description: Evidence classifications supplied by the licensed provider; retained as provider claims.

date_window_start.description: Inclusive lower bound of an estimated date window. The date field is its index, not a confirmed occurrence date.

date_window_end.description: Inclusive upper bound of an estimated date window.

verification_url.description: Evidence checked for the stored schedule, e.g. official network configuration. May differ from the human-readable announcement in source_url.

verification_method.description: Verification basis, e.g. github-json for an official configuration fetch or manual for a reviewed roadmap.

manually_reviewed_at.description: Fixed timestamp of human source review, when relevant; snapshot generation never advances this timestamp.

discovery_url.description: Optional discovery-page link, which may identify a calendar aggregator. It is not primary verification evidence or a licence claim; source_id, source_url and verification_url retain the independent primary-source provenance. Internal provider API payloads are not distributed.

country.description: ISO country code, or null for global crypto events. Global is not a country code.

assets.description: Affected assets; empty for economic and exchange holiday rows.

next_date_window_start.description: Inclusive bound of the next event estimated date window, when supplied. next_date is its lower-bound index, not a confirmed occurrence date.

next_date_window_end.description: Inclusive bound of the next event estimated date window, when supplied. next_date is its lower-bound index, not a confirmed occurrence date.

old.description: Previous or updated semantic value, including structured observations and revision history. Routine successful fetch timestamps do not create changes.

new.description: Previous or updated semantic value, including structured observations and revision history. Routine successful fetch timestamps do not create changes.

source_licenses.description: Records may retain additional original-source attribution and licence requirements.

source_rights.description: Independently normalised facts retain provenance and access-basis metadata without asserting a publisher copyright licence.

fetched_at.description: Null if no successful live fetch occurred; checked-in schedules do not count as a fetch.

error.description: Credential-safe collector diagnostic, without request URLs or response bodies.

reported.description: False for snapshots without source-health reporting; this means unknown, not healthy.

stale_events.description: Events explicitly marked as retained last-good data during source outages.

ObservationSummary.description: Mapped numerical evidence only; current means collection succeeded, not first-print availability or real-time delivery.

EventDataQuality.description: Versioned engine-observed field contract. Null for legacy snapshots. Collection verification and freshness are independent of schedule timing; capture timestamps are not publisher publication or API availability timestamps.

DatasetQuality.description: Canonical full-snapshot field coverage. Counts describe available evidence and gaps, not release capture success, independent accuracy measurement, complete global coverage or a latency SLA.

reported.description: False means the snapshot has no supported versioned quality report; it does not mean healthy or complete.

OfficialObservation.description: Canonical engine-validated observation evidence retained without modifying publisher units, credits or document manifests. known_at is an engine capture timestamp. revision_history records engine-observed value changes, not guaranteed original first prints. Additional fields vary by source.

reported.description: Supported engine quality reporting is present; false on unsupported legacy snapshots.

CollectionContext.description: Allowlisted collection cycle metadata. A numerical-only refresh does not reverify schedules; compare schedule_snapshot_at separately from snapshot generated_at.

key_prefix.description: Display prefix, never the complete key.

tier.description: Effective active plan. A captured signup awaiting payment receives HTTP402 rather than a Free allowance.

used_today.description: Admitted requests today in UTC. Shared across account keys when owned; rejected429/authentication requests do not consume quota.

created_at.description: Key creation time in UTC, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

last_used_at.description: Last recorded activity in UTC, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS; legacy updates may be cache-throttled for 60 seconds.

requests_total.description: Unknown lifetime total. The old numeric field was cache-throttled and undercounted requests; it is now null.

legacy_activity_samples.description: Old cache-throttled counter retained for diagnosis; not a request total or elapsed-minute count.

retained_requests.description: All attempts logged within usage_window, including rate-limit rejections. Not successful requests, unique users or a lifetime total.

last_30_days_since.description: Inclusive start of exactly 30 UTC dates including today.

quota_scope.description: Present for keys linked to a verified WordPress account. Daily usage and allowance cover all keys belonging to that account, including revoked keys.

key_used_today.description: This key only: admitted requests today in UTC after quota accounting activation.

retained_requests_scope.description: Retained history continues to describe this key only.

quota_basis.description: Daily and monthly allowance use admissions; authentication and429 rejections do not consume quota.

key_attempted_today.description: Raw attempts by this key today in UTC, including rejected retries.

attempted_today.description: Raw attempts today in UTC, pooled across account keys when owned; this key otherwise. Excludes requests blocked beforeWordPress.

successful_today.description: Account-owned keys only: recorded2xx GET responses on the origin telemetry routes. Partial outcome coverage, not client delivery.

blocked_today.description: Account-owned keys only: recorded429 GET responses on the origin telemetry routes. Excludes edge blocks.

monthly_limit.description: Free or Starter account calendar-month allowance, shared across all keys. Null for retained legacy, Pro or Business access.

used_this_month.description: Admitted account requests in the current UTC calendar month. Includes admissions on revoked keys, excludes denied retries.

remaining_this_month.description: Remaining shared calendar-month allowance; null when no monthly cap applies.

monthly_resets_at.description: First instant of the next UTC calendar month.

KeyUsageWindow.description: Exactly 90 UTC dates including today, applied even if physical log pruning is late. A shorter observed history is not backfilled.

id.description: Canonical asset ID; symbols are display labels, not stable IDs.

x-attribution.how: A visible link to https://www.financecalendar.com near the data, or on your credits page.

x-rate-limits.monthly_reset: 00:00 UTC on the first day of the next calendar month
